name: Penobscot Marine Museum Kids Summer Camp
description_short: Week long themed day camp at the Penobscot Marine Museum in Searsport for ages 5 to 10. Days mix crafts, games, music and exhibit visits on sea and coastal themes, and campers help with the museum's daily Set Sail demonstrations.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds until 9 pm the day before the program, minus a 10 percent fee; none after that.
